title: ID card
description:
It's your employee ID badge. 
You can put it on clothing.
details: This is a laminated card with a colorful print and a metal clip for attaching to clothing. It looks impressive and corporate.
It's immediately obvious that Syntrack doesn't skimp on the little things. You're pleased to see your name on this.
The photo came out surprisingly well. You look like someone who makes responsible decisions.
